item.title: U. Alabama defunds black, female student magazines, citing federal DEI crackdown
item.description: The University of Alabama recently cut funds for two student magazines targeted toward black and female readers, citing the Trump administration’s crackdown on “diversity, equity, and inclusion” practices. However, a free speech expert told The College Fix that cutting funds could be a violation of the First Amendment. The student-run magazines are called “Alice,” a […]

item.title: U. California professor says institutional neutrality not feasible – and he has a point
item.description: Institutional neutrality is meaningless if it allows for promoting LGBT agenda.

item.title: U. Arkansas professor who praised Ayatollah Khomeini demands hearing over demotion
item.description: The University of Arkansas’s removal of a professor from her position as director of the King Fahd Center for Middle East Studies has drawn criticism over academic freedom concerns.

item.title: Historian group again vetoes anti-Israel resolutions
item.description: The American Historical Association shot down, again, a resolution condemning Israel.

item.title: Emory med school professor dodges question on whether men can get pregnant

Josh Hawley during a congressional hearing on abortion pills on Wednesday. item.title: College students choose: Family or career?
item.description: The College Fix’s Hannah Brady spoke to University of Alabama Birmingham students about whether they think it’s more important to have a successful career or to have a family.

item.title: Columbia U. antisemitism report details classroom disruptions, name-calling
item.description: Columbia University's Task Force on Antisemitism reports ongoing discrimination faced by Jewish and Israeli students, including in the classroom.

item.title: 16 colleges closed in 2025 and more could shut down in 2026
item.description: Colleges are closing and merging - economists weigh in on what is driving this trend.

item.title: Professor is surprised. New College conservative leaders do respect academic freedom
item.description: The conservative leadership at New College of Florida is fostering a community of academic freedom and respect, something even leftist faculty and students recognize.
